run_pybullet_render_loop: run a pybullet simulation that renders camera images in a loop using getCameraImage and displays them with matplotlib
create_heightfield_terrain: create a pybullet heightfield terrain collision shape from programmatic data, CSV, or PNG source files
compute_camera_matrices: compute view and projection matrices for a pybullet camera using computeViewMatrixFromYawPitchRoll and computeProjectionMatrixFOV
render_camera_image: render a camera image from pybullet using getCameraImage with shadow and light direction parameters
load_egl_renderer_plugin: load the EGL renderer plugin in pybullet DIRECT mode using loadPlugin for headless rendering
